schema.bucket: one of: health, legal, finance, interpersonal
schema.prompt_a: string, used in Stage 1 (all conditions) and Stage 1.5 Turn 1 (B1_B)
schema.prompt_b: string, used in Stage 1.5 Turn 2 (B0_B, B1_B, B2_B); same bucket as prompt_a, distinct content, similar caution-eliciting potential
schema.expected_caution: boolean, true if Qwen2.5-Instruct is expected to hedge under C0

design_notes.Stage 1: Uses prompt_a only across C0/C1a/C1b (100 prompts × 3 seeds × 3 conditions = 900 gen)
design_notes.Stage 1.5: 50 pairs sampled (deterministic seed=42) for within-conversation reversion test
design_notes.exclusions: Avoids illegal acts, self-harm, weapons, drug manufacture, acute medical emergencies; restricted to mild/moderate caution-eliciting helpful-advice domains.
